test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As on 4th February 2022 which one of the following scheme caters to primary needs of women in difficult circumstances - women and girls rendered homeless due to family discord, crime, violence, mental stress, social ostracism or are being forced into prostitution and are in moral danger?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swadhar Greh Scheme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Swadhar Greh scheme

 
 
• The scheme deals with providing basic facilities like food, clothing, shelter, and medical facilities for those women who are in distress.
 
• The program is implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
 
• It also envisions that the special needs of these women are properly taken care of and under no circumstances they should be left unattended or abandoned which could lead to their exploitation and desolation.
 
• Women affected by domestic violence could stay up to one year.
 
• Under the Scheme , Swadhar Greh will be set up in every district with capacity of 30 women.
 
• For big cities and other districts having more than 40 lakh population or those districts where there is a need for additional support to the women, more than one Swadhar Greh could be established.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** One Stop Centres (OSCs)**

 
 
• ​To help violence affected women, the centre has approved setting up of 100 additional One Stop Centres (OSC) in 9 states and these states are Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Mizoram, Nagaland, Odisha, Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh. The scheme is operated by the Women and Child Development Ministry since 2015 having 189 branches across the country. The sole purpose of these OSCs is to facilitate integrated services to those women’s by providing them services like police assistance; medical aid, psycho-social counseling and all these can now be available under one roof.
 
 
 
• **​​Ujjawala Scheme**
 
 
• It was launched by the prime minister of India Narendra Modi.
 
• It was launched on 1st May 2016.
 
• Its goal is to distribute 50 million LPG connections to women of BPL families.
 
• It is a scheme introduced to safeguard the health of women and children by providing them with a clean cooking fuel LPG.
 
• With the use of LPG, women don't have to compromise their health in smoking kitchens.
 
• It also provided a safeguard against wandering in unsafe areas to collect firewood.
 
 
 
• **National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)**
 
 
• NSAP primarily targets vulnerable sections of society, including elderly individuals, widows, and persons with disabilities.
 
• The program provides monthly pensions to eligible beneficiaries to support their basic needs and livelihoods.
 
• NSAP comprises various pension schemes such as the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS), Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS), and Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS).
 
• NSAP operates across rural and urban areas of India, aiming to provide financial security and social assistance to disadvantaged individuals.
 
• Eligibility for pension under NSAP typically depends on factors such as age, income status, disability, and marital status.
 
• The program is funded and implemented by the central government, with the objective of ensuring a minimum level of financial support and social security for vulnerable groups in society.
